hero_summary.headline: You have a low cooperative orientation and place more emphasis on true judgment, boundaries, and the problem itself.
hero_summary.body_core: You usually don't put aside differences easily in order to maintain superficial harmony, and prefer to deal directly with disagreements.

domains_overview.snapshot_line: When agreeableness is low, your advantage is sobriety and boundaries, at the expense of expression that needs to avoid being too sharp.

domain_deep_dive.definition: Agreeableness reflects trust, cooperation, consideration, concessions, and relationship orientation when dealing with conflict.
strengths: You can see the irrationality more
Not easily kidnapped by relationship pressure
Ability to maintain positions on key issues
costs: It may be harder for others to feel caught
It is necessary to proactively distinguish between principled issues and expressions
domain_deep_dive.daily_life: You would rather explain the problem clearly than try to keep the atmosphere comfortable first.

core_portrait.identity: Your relationship system is more about boundaries and judgment.
core_portrait.default_style: You will first see if something makes sense before deciding whether to cooperate.

norms_comparison.relative_meaning: In the reference sample, your cooperation orientation is relatively low, indicating that you more naturally put boundaries and facts first.

action_plan.priority_hint: Your actions focus on preserving a clear position while changing key expressions from confrontational advances to understandable boundary statements.

hero_summary.headline: Your cooperative orientation is in the middle, taking care of others without completely giving up your own boundaries.
hero_summary.body_core: You are willing to understand the needs in the relationship, but you will usually also observe whether the other person is reasonable and worthy of continued investment.

domains_overview.snapshot_line: When Agreeableness is in the middle, you can cooperate and reserve judgment; the key lies in whether boundary expression is timely enough.

domain_deep_dive.definition: Agreeableness determines how you balance relationships and positions in cooperation, trust, consideration, conflict, and concessions.
strengths: Able to understand other people’s situations
It’s not easy to make unprincipled concessions
Suitable for balancing relationships and problems
costs: Complex relationships may require clearer standards
Easily adjust input based on object quality
domain_deep_dive.daily_life: You are generally willing to cooperate, but if the other person continues to cross boundaries or is unfair, you will gradually withdraw your investment.

core_portrait.identity: Your relationship system is a combination of understanding and boundaries.
core_portrait.default_style: You try to understand first and then decide how deeply to invest based on the quality of the interaction.

norms_comparison.relative_meaning: In the reference sample, your agreeableness is close to the middle, indicating that the tendency to cooperate exists, but it is not an unconditional priority.

action_plan.priority_hint: The focus of your actions is to draw the line between "can cooperate" and "cannot continue to bear" earlier.

hero_summary.headline: Your cooperative orientation is high, making it easier to understand others, maintain relationships, and reduce conflicts.
hero_summary.body_core: You usually consider the other person's feelings and the overall atmosphere first, and are more willing to use consideration, negotiation, and concessions to push things forward.

domains_overview.snapshot_line: When Agreeableness is high, your advantage is cooperation and commitment, but the price is that you need to avoid taking too much responsibility for others.

domain_deep_dive.definition: Agreeableness reflects tendencies toward trust, empathy, cooperation, gentle expression, and relationship maintenance.
strengths: Good at seeing other people’s needs and relationship atmosphere
costs: It is easy to take other people’s difficulties as one’s own responsibility
Need to prevent concessions from masking true boundaries
domain_deep_dive.daily_life: You often take care of relationships and feelings first before addressing your own needs.

core_portrait.identity: Your relationship system is more accepting and collaborative.
core_portrait.default_style: You'll strive to keep things moving with less friction, and you'll need to make your boundaries visible as well.

norms_comparison.relative_meaning: In the reference sample, your cooperative orientation is more prominent, indicating that consideration and relationship maintenance are more likely to become your natural reactions.

action_plan.priority_hint: Your actions focus on retaining your empathic edge while making rejections, needs, and discomforts clearer.
